name: stage5-browser
description: Reliability-first browser control for AI agents.

interface.shortDescription: Reliable, recoverable browser control for agents.
interface.longDescription: Stage5 Browser provides isolated persistent sessions, private native-browser authentication with same-process Chromium attachment, runtime-profile and storage-continuity diagnostics, modal-scoped semantic inspection, snapshot-bound scrolling with virtualization-safe reference actions, local file selection with upload-state evidence, postcondition verification, cross-origin frame control, versioned recovery, and privacy-minimized automation/page/action diagnostics through MCP.
defaultPrompt: Open a page and inspect its semantic structure.
Search an infinite timeline using bounded scrolling and rendered-text search.
Open the isolated profile privately for login, attach to the same browser process, then verify the signed-in state.
Attach an authorized local file to an observed file input and verify its processing state before posting.
Check the current browser session and tabs.
Diagnose why a browser profile cannot start.
Recover the browser and reopen the last page.
